item.title: Bulletin updated at 02:50 HKT 14/Apr/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a very dry continental airstream, as well as sand and dust weather, in addition to weak winds, visibility will be relatively low over Guangdong today and tomorrow. The temperature difference between day and night will be rather large. A southerly airstream is expected to affect the coastal areas gradually in the middle and latter parts of this week. The weather will be relatively humid over the region. A trough of low pressure will bring showers to inland Guangdong in the latter part of this week and early next week.
